parts:
TLDR: follow this link to make an account on farm:  https://wiki.cse.ucdavis.edu/cgi-bin/index2.pl

Hey folks, 

February 23 will be a mini-workshop on how to run an R-studio interface on the UC Davis CAES HPC cluster, fondly referred to as farm. Affiliates of the College of Ag and Science are eligible for a free account that provides access to farm. 

If you are affiliated with CAES and would like to sign up for a farm account prior to the workshop, follow the instructions below. Unfortunately farm is only accessible for affiliates of CAES, however, if you are not in CAES but would like to see how Rstudio is run on a cluster, please come :) 

To request an account on farm go to this link: https://wiki.cse.ucdavis.edu/cgi-bin/index2.pl

You will see

"Which cluster are you applying for an account on?" Select farm/caes in the dropdown. 

"Who is sponsoring your account" select Getchell, Adam in the dropdown. 

You will also need an SSH public key to upload. You can find instructions for generating one here: https://hpc.ucdavis.edu/faq#ssh-key, or here. 

This should work for anyone in CAES, you will be contacted by the farm support folks once they have set it up or if they need something additional. They may ask for your advisor's email to confirm the request. It should take only a few days to get the account set up. 

Cheers, 
Reed Kenny
PhD Candidate
Potter Lab, UC Davis
